blinding_guess.why: The sysfs branch reads energy_full into design_capacity and energy_full_design into last_full_capacity (lines 120-121), the reverse of the attribute names and of the /proc branch mapping; sysfs integers (kernel micro-units, and power_now is a power not a current) are stored unscaled into fields declared Ah/A/V; status is lowercased but not stripped of its newline, so the state lookup falls back to 0 (DISCHARGING); _read_number catches exceptions.ValueError without importing exceptions.

notes: All nine packet elements are kernel file interfaces consumed (read) by scripts/laptop_battery.py; none is a ROS topic/service, so msg_type, QoS and definition_id are null (ROS 1, no message definition). The directory comes from private param ~acpi_path (default "/proc/acpi/battery/BAT0", line 209; snapshot launch passes $(optenv TURTLEBOT_BATTERY /proc/acpi/battery/BAT0), turtlebot_bringup/launch/minimal.launch:3 and includes/netbook.launch.xml:7). If the path starts with '/proc' the code reads <path>/info and <path>/state (parsed with yaml.load); otherwise it reads <path>/energy_full, energy_full_design, energy_now, power_now, voltage_now, present, status (lines 120-121, 163-171). The string /sys/class/power_supply/BAT0 appears nowhere in the snapshot: the seven sysfs elements' directory is supplied at run time, so they have ports but are in neither references nor declares. Units on sysfs ports are the units the LaptopChargeStatus field comments state for the field the raw int() value is written into; the code applies no conversion to sysfs values. Mapping as written: energy_full -> design_capacity (line 120), energy_full_design -> last_full_capacity -> msg.capacity (lines 121, 264); /proc branch maps 'design capacity' -> design_capacity (line 117). status: _read_string(...).lower() with no strip, looked up in state_to_val keys 'charged','full','charging','discharging','unknown', default 0 = DISCHARGING (lines 125-129, 163-164); present: _read_number(...) == 1. _read_number catches exceptions.ValueError (line 105) but 'exceptions' is never imported. rate_hz is the polling rate set in code (info 1/60.0 Hz, state 1/5.0 Hz); the code also treats data older than 5 periods (300 s info, 25 s state) as stale (lines 259-260), a staleness window rather than a stated rate, so min_rate_hz is left null. No packet element is provided, so declares/not_declared are empty. Other interfaces of this node (not packet elements): publishes topic laptop_charge (linux_hardware/LaptopChargeStatus, latch=True) and /diagnostics (diagnostic_msgs/DiagnosticArray) at 1 Hz (lines 205-206, 287).
